name: ui-tick
prompt: A single short dry UI tick, like a small wooden peg tapped once on a slate board, crisp high transient, no reverb.

name: ui-back
prompt: A short soft descending wooden tap, like a chalk stick set down on a slate ledge, quick low transient, dry.

name: focus
prompt: A very quiet faint glassy ping, like a fingertip touching a small brass bell without ringing it, extremely short and soft.

name: chalk-stroke-p1
prompt: A single chalk stick drawing one short stroke across a rough slate blackboard, bright scratchy high-pitched squeak and grainy texture.

name: chalk-stroke-p2
prompt: A single chalk stick drawing one short stroke across a rough slate blackboard, slightly lower and duller scratchy drag than a bright stroke.

name: place-impact-p1
prompt: A chalk stroke on slate ending with a firm tap, bright chalk scratch followed by a soft wooden thump as the stick presses into the board.

name: place-impact-p2
prompt: A dull chalk stroke on slate ending with a firm tap, lower scratchy drag followed by a soft deep wooden thump on the board.

name: invalid
prompt: A short dull rejected buzz, like a knuckle rapping twice quickly on a hollow wooden desk, muted and flat.

name: turn-pass
prompt: A single gentle finger tap on a wooden table edge, soft neutral mid-pitched knock, dry and brief.

name: win
prompt: A short celebratory rising chime sequence, like four small tuned metal bars struck in ascending order with a light shimmering wash at the end.

name: lose
prompt: A short somber descending sequence, like three soft muted marimba notes falling stepwise, quiet and resigned.

name: draw
prompt: Two soft neutral bell tones struck one after another at the same pitch, like a small hand bell tapped twice gently, even and unresolved.

name: clock-warning
prompt: A single small clockwork tick-ping, like the escapement of an old mechanical chess clock clicking once sharply.

name: achievement
prompt: A bright two-note sparkle chime, like a tiny glockenspiel struck twice in quick rising steps with a faint shimmering tail.
